boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain St Lawrence University
boards.description: Verified evening food stops on campus and around Canton, with current availability noted for each.

cards.title: Crave Cafe
cards.subtitle: 67 Main Street, Canton
cards.notes: Use the Saturday after-midnight pickup window when it fits your plans; confirm ordering availability before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street option with a listed Saturday window into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Crave Cafe’s official Toast ordering page lists Saturday hours of 12:00 a.m.–2:15 a.m. and identifies the location as 67 Main Street, Canton.
cards.source_title: Crave Cafe online ordering and hours
cards.access_notes: Listed Saturday hours are 12:00 a.m.–2:15 a.m.; check the live ordering page before going.

cards.title: Northstar Café
cards.subtitle: Sullivan Student Center, St. Lawrence University
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of the Student Center for a campus-based food stop; check Dining Services for the day’s service details.
cards.short_summary: The campus café identified by St. Lawrence as opening early and staying open late.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence University states that Northstar Café is on the lower level of the Sullivan Student Center and “opens early, stays open late.”
cards.access_notes: The university describes it as staying open late but does not publish a specific closing time on this page; verify current service before visiting.

cards.title: The Corner
cards.subtitle: Pi Nu Epsilon Atrium, Chaney Dining Center, SUNY Canton
cards.notes: For an evening food run, use the Sunday–Thursday late-night program at Chaney Dining Center and check campus status first.
cards.short_summary: A nearby campus late-night program with pizza, calzones, sandwiches, and drinks.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Canton lists The Corner’s Sunday–Thursday late-night program from 8:00 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. in the Pi Nu Epsilon Atrium at Chaney Dining Center.
cards.access_notes: Listed Sunday–Thursday hours are 8:00–10:30 p.m.; access is on the SUNY Canton campus.

cards.title: Parkway Express Canton
cards.subtitle: 5994 US Highway 11, Canton
cards.notes: Use this Route 11 stop for a later convenience-food run; check the store directly if a holiday or weather event affects service.
cards.short_summary: A Canton convenience stop whose operator lists daily evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Parkway Express identifies its Canton location at 5994 US Highway 11 and lists daily hours of 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Operator-listed hours are Sunday–Saturday, 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: 11 West
cards.subtitle: 6182 US-11, Canton
cards.notes: Plan around the dinner service rather than bar hours, and confirm the kitchen is serving before making the trip north of campus.
cards.short_summary: A Canton restaurant with dinner service listed through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: 11 West lists dinner service Tuesday–Sunday from 4:30 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. at 6182 US-11 in Canton.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant dinner is listed Tuesday–Sunday, 4:30–9:00 p.m.; the venue is closed Mondays.

cards.title: Sergi's Italian Restaurant & Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 31 Main Street, Canton
cards.notes: Use the Main Street pizzeria during its listed evening service; check the live ordering page before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated Canton pizzeria with nightly service listed until 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Sergi’s official ordering page lists 31 Main Street, Canton, with service Monday–Saturday from 4:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Sergi's Italian Restaurant & Pizzeria online ordering and hours
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Saturday, 4:00–9:00 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: County Seat Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Best Western University Inn, 90 East Main Street, Canton
cards.notes: Choose from the food and nonalcoholic menu at this East Main Street restaurant, then confirm pickup or seating before you go.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant at the University Inn that lists food service until 9 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: The County Seat Restaurant’s official Toast page lists its address as 90 East Main Street, Canton, and daily hours of 7:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: County Seat Restaurant online ordering and hours
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 7:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; the official menu includes nonalcoholic beverages.

cards.title: Not Just Sandwiches
cards.subtitle: 5994 U.S. Route 11, Canton
cards.notes: Use the Route 11 pickup option for an evening sandwich, grill, or pizza order, checking the live page for ordering status first.
cards.short_summary: A takeout-focused Canton food counter that lists service through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Not Just Sandwiches’ official Toast page lists its Canton location at 5994 U.S. Route 11 and says it closes at 9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Not Just Sandwiches online ordering and hours
cards.access_notes: The live ordering page lists a 9:00 p.m. close; ordering availability can change.

cards.title: Dana Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: St. Lawrence University campus
cards.notes: Use Dana for an on-campus evening meal and check Dining Services before going, especially during breaks or schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: St. Lawrence’s main dining hall, open every day into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence University states that Dana Dining Hall is open seven days a week from 7:30 a.m. to 8:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: University-listed hours are daily, 7:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; hours may differ during breaks.

cards.title: Chaney Dining Center
cards.subtitle: SUNY Canton campus
cards.notes: Use Chaney’s continuous evening dining service when it is available, then verify guest and meal-plan access before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A nearby campus dining hall with daily service into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Canton lists Chaney Dining Center hours as 7:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m. Saturday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed closing time is 7:30 p.m. every day; verify current campus access and payment arrangements.
